panels.title: Orders per minute
panels.description: Distinct orders per minute from orders_per_minute (uniqExactMerge over the per-minute aggregate state).

targets.rawSql: SELECT minute AS time, uniqExactMerge(orders) AS orders FROM streamline.orders_per_minute WHERE $__timeFilter(minute) GROUP BY minute ORDER BY minute

panels.title: Revenue per minute (materialized view)
panels.description: Revenue from orders_per_minute revenue_cents, in currency units. A plain sum: it can overcount after a full replay with different batch boundaries. Compare with the exact revenue stat below.

targets.rawSql: SELECT minute AS time, sum(revenue_cents)/100 AS revenue FROM streamline.orders_per_minute WHERE $__timeFilter(minute) GROUP BY minute ORDER BY minute

panels.title: Exact revenue (ORDER_PAID, FINAL)
panels.description: Sum of total_cents for ORDER_PAID events in the selected range, read from orders_raw FINAL so duplicates are collapsed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(total_cents)/100 AS exact_revenue FROM streamline.orders_raw FINAL WHERE event_type='ORDER_PAID' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)

panels.title: Duplicates collapsed
panels.description: Raw rows minus rows after FINAL. Shows how many duplicate deliveries the ReplacingMergeTree has collapsed. Reads the whole table, so it is not limited by the time picker.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() - (SELECT count() FROM streamline.orders_raw FINAL) AS duplicates_collapsed FROM streamline.orders_raw

panels.title: Ingest lag per minute (seconds)
panels.description: Maximum of ingested_at minus occurred_at per minute, from orders_raw. Measures how far behind event time the pipeline writes rows.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMinute(occurred_at) AS time, max(dateDiff('millisecond', occurred_at, ingested_at)) / 1000 AS lag_seconds FROM streamline.orders_raw WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Top 10 SKUs by net stock change
panels.description: Sum of net_delta per SKU from inventory_by_sku. Negative values are reservations that exceed restocks.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sku, sum(net_delta) AS net_delta FROM streamline.inventory_by_sku GROUP BY sku ORDER BY net_delta DESC LIMIT 10
